# Tier 3 benchmark results

<!-- Generated by `python -m benchmarks page`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Does the interior change anything? The same conversations run against configurations set by levers, scored on the same rubric.

Part of the benchmark suite (#65, `docs/ROADMAP-STABILIZATION.md`). Harness: `backend/benchmarks/`. Every run is listed, including failed and budget-stopped ones. Rubric items are scored by a judge model, which is not told the model or configuration; a judge score is one model's reading of a transcript, not ground truth.

Criteria: `docs/benchmarks/criteria-DRAFT.md` is a **draft, not adopted**; Kohl decides the criteria. A run made against draft criteria is marked DRAFT below, and its pass/fail lines are provisional.
Errors count as failures (criteria draft G2): an errored cell or a failed turn scores 0 on its rubric items and its checks count as failed. Budget stops and judge errors are "not measured".

Runs belong in a git worktree or a clone, never the live checkout: the harness's checkout guard only detects a symlinked `backend/data` or a `cass.db` in `backend/data` or `data/`.

The `self_context_off` configuration is a **placeholder** until the self-context design (#63) exists; differences against it don't measure the designed section.
